title: V12 SIGNATURE — IGNITION
description: Signature showcase for the V12 SIGNATURE pack: 128 BPM, A minor, 14 bars plus a released tail, exactly 28.000 s. IGNITION (1–2) bell, boom and space; ORBIT (3–6) the hypnotic SIGNAL cell over a rolling ABYSS/REACTOR bass with the hook foreshadowed by the SPECTER choir; ASCENSION (7–8) E pedal, snare roll and riser; CONVERGENCE (9–12) the PHANTOM hook over Am–F–G–E with a pumping held sub; AFTERGLOW (13–14) the hook resolves to A5 as the bell returns. Every sound is a V12 SIGNATURE asset; no General MIDI.

tracks.description: SUB HAMMER (tight in the groove, longer in the drop) layered with IRON PULSE from bar 9; choke group "kick".
NEON CLAP backbeats, the TITANIUM CRACK build roll, and both stacked in the drop.
GHOST TICK sixteenths and gated OPEN CIRCUIT off-beats; choke group "hats".
CHROME STRIKE: the bell that opens, marks each section and closes the piece.
ABYSS: a held A1 opening, rolling sub sixteenths in the groove, held roots pumping under the drop.
REACTOR: the rolling growl over ABYSS in the groove, off-beat stabs in the drop; high-passed so ABYSS owns the sub.
SIGNAL: the hypnotic three-note cell that runs from bar 2 to the end, with a dotted-eighth echo.
PHANTOM: the hook, stated in the drop and resolved to a held A5.
EVENT HORIZON: the open-fifth space under every section, following the roots in the drop.
AFTERGLOW: four-note chords from the groove onward, pumping in the drop.
SPECTER: the hook foreshadowed an octave down as a ghost choir, the held "ah" of the build, the final chord top.
ASCENSION: a one-bar lift into the groove and the two-bar build, each ending exactly on its downbeat.
CONVERGENCE: the drop and the final downbeat.
